# KashCake

> KashCake is a free, open-source Android app for birthday and anniversary reminders from your contacts. It has no internet access, never changes contacts, and collects nothing. Made by OneKash Labs (https://onekash.org).

Full text for AI assistants: https://kashcake.onekash.org/llms-full.txt

## Get it

- [Join the Google Play beta](https://kashcake.onekash.org/beta/)
- [APK on GitHub Releases](https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashCake/releases)
- Requires Android 12 or later.

## Links

- [Source code (Apache-2.0)](https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashCake)

- [Report a problem](https://github.com/OneKashLabs/KashCake/issues)

- [KashCal](https://kashcal.onekash.org): all your calendars in one private Android app.
- [KashPass](https://kashpass.onekash.org): your KeePass vault on Android, with no internet permission.
- [iCloud Calendar MCP](https://mcp.onekash.org): your iCloud Calendar for AI agents.
